title: Content of Calamity
description: This mod is a project of mine that adds some of my less silly ideas to the game. There's cool mobs, items and more to discover! No promises on seriousness though!
body:
Please not that this is more of an alpha build but I really wanted to get this out to you all :)  

Content of Calamity is a goofy project of mine that adds cool mobs, items and blocks to the game! And this whole thing somehow started with Minecraft Live theories! This mod is currently in an unfinished version - but just because I wanted to get this out to the world as soon as possible! (and my ADHD brain kept giving me EVEN MORE TASKS)  
*COUGH* anyway, I hope you all enjoy! Please note that there may be some copyrighted sounds here so I really hope I'm safe ;-;  

Features Include:  

-The Nautilus: a tamable mount and his MANY MANY cousins  
-The Meeking: a shy variant of the Creaking  
-A work-in-progress guide book currently accessed by right-clicking a normal book
-The Spruce and Acacia Creakings
-And so much more!

Made with MCreator.
